title: Investigation Capability Validation — Board H
purpose: Use Challenge Registry, Question History, and Session Links to measure how close current infrastructure is to the target May Investigation Workbench. Map capability maturity across 5 levels.

challenge_registry.description: 35 challenges across 6 types (CONTENT_ERROR, TECHNICAL_ISSUE, ANSWER_DISPUTE, EXPLANATION_ISSUE, AMBIGUITY, OTHER). 19 sessions linked. 2 REC-IDs linked. Stored in scripts/output/challenge_registry.json.

question_history.description: 2,540 items indexed. 564 items have session links (defect, certification, or challenge history). Stored in scripts/output/question_history.json.
question_history.coverage: 2,540/2,540 items indexed. 564/2,540 (22.2%) have recorded history — primarily Certified or defect-affected items. Non-Certified items may have zero recorded history.

session_registry.description: Session registry indexing sessions with their associated QIDs. Stored in scripts/output/session_registry.json.

workflow_completeness.verdict: FULLY_LINKED — All 5 link types validated operational by S206 Board F. The Challenge→Recommendation→Session→Resolution chain is architecturally complete.

investigation_capability_maturity_model.description: 5-level maturity model for investigation infrastructure, culminating in the May Investigation Workbench (Level 5).

level_1_ad_hoc.description: No structured investigation support. Defects found manually. Investigation is grep-based narrative searching.
level_1_ad_hoc.evidence: All defect detection in v1 was manual — 22+ DL-008 scan events, each ad-hoc grep-based with ~75% false-positive rate.

level_2_structured_index.description: Structured indices exist. QID→Session, Session→QID, Challenge→Question linkages are queryable (manually or semi-automatically).
level_2_structured_index.evidence: Challenge Registry, Question History, Session Registry operational. All 5 link types validated. 35 challenges, 2,540 indexed items, 564 items with history.
level_2_structured_index.current_capability: Data is structured but queries are not programmatic — investigation requires reading JSON files and cross-referencing manually. No investigation UI or query interface exists.

level_3_queryable_investigation.description: Programmatic queries across all indices. Can answer: 'Which sessions touched QID X?', 'What defects does QID X have?', 'What is the certification path of QID X?'
level_3_queryable_investigation.gap: No query interface exists. IQ-001 through IQ-009 are partially supported (grep-based). Full programmatic support requires a query layer (e.g., a script that accepts QID as input and returns all linked data).

level_4_investigation_workbench.description: May Investigation Workbench (backend): Student→Challenge→Question→Session→Recommendation→Resolution chain fully automated. Admin can accept/reject challenges, assign reviewers, track remediation progress.
level_4_investigation_workbench.gap: Student data feed not yet operational. Real student challenges are synthetic data. May Administration Portal at placeholder status. 5 escalation paths (ESC-001 through ESC-005) are NOT_BUILT. RBAC specified but not operational.

escalation_path_readiness.ESC-001_learner_flags_item: NOT_BUILT (requires May Coaching Layer + Admin Portal)
escalation_path_readiness.ESC-004_finding_remediation: NOT_BUILT (remediation assignment defined but not integrated)

level_5_fully_integrated.description: May Investigation Workbench (full): Integrated with live exam engine. Real student challenges flow from learner→May→Admin→remediation→verification→closure. Adaptive learning adjustments based on challenge outcomes. Analytics dashboard for question performance.
level_5_fully_integrated.gap: Requires Level 4 completion + live exam engine integration + real student data + adaptive learning infrastructure. This is a post-800-series target.

investigation_capability_maturity_model.current_maturity: LEVEL 2 (Structured Index) — All indices are built and data-linked, but investigation is manual (read JSON files, cross-reference by QID). Transition to Level 3 requires a programmatic query layer (QID→aggregate-all-data script).
investigation_capability_maturity_model.distance_to_target_level_5: 3 levels remaining. Level 3 (queryable) requires a single investigation query script. Level 4 (workbench) requires the May Administration Portal. Level 5 (integrated) requires live exam engine integration and real student data.

s207_investigation_readiness_validation.s207_finding: Investigation infrastructure OPERATIONAL. Student→Challenge→Question→Session→Recommendation→Resolution chain architecturally complete. Backend ready for May Administration Portal. Student data feed and UI pending 800-Series Phase 3.
s207_investigation_readiness_validation.s352_re_verification: INFRASTRUCTURE_STABLE — No changes between S207 and S352 (both read-only). All indices, links, and registries unchanged. Challenge count (35), QID count (2,540), link counts all identical.
s207_investigation_readiness_validation.alignment: S207 and S352 investigations converge: infrastructure is at Level 2 maturity (structured, indexed, but not programmatically queryable). The path to Level 3 is low-cost (one query script). Level 4-5 require the May Admin Portal and live student data.

critical_gaps.remediation: Write a single investigation_query.js script that accepts QID and returns aggregated defect, session, recommendation, and challenge data from all registries. Estimated: ~100 lines, 1 session.
Delta ledger must track per-item gate transitions (Unprocessed→Gate -1→Gate 0→...→Certified). Requires gate-history logging in scan artifact, not just current state.
800-Series Phase 3: build admin portal with Challenge Workbench, reviewer assignment, remediation tracking. Not scoped for 350-Series.
All 35 current challenges are synthetic (author-generated). Real student challenges require live deployment with exam engine → May Coaching Layer → Challenge button integration.

low_cost_quick_wins.impact: Transitions from Level 2 to Level 3 maturity
low_cost_quick_wins.output: Single command: node scripts/investigation_query.js P1E-C-054 → returns all defects, sessions, recs, challenges

verdict: INVESTIGATION_CAPABILITY_LEVEL_2 — All indices operational (Challenge Registry, Question History, Session Registry). All 5 link types validated (Challenge→Question, Challenge→Session, Challenge→Recommendation, Question→History, Question→Session). 35 challenges tracked across 6 types with 5 statuses. Distance to target Level 5 (May Investigation Workbench): 3 levels. Lowest-cost next step: programmatic query layer (1 session, ~100 lines) → Level 3 (Queryable Investigation). Level 4-5 require 800-Series May Portal development.
